I wasn't able to write these notes. My first attempt to fetch the sources failed with the message "no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn." That tool is my only way to search or read web pages, and my other tools can't go online. So I haven't read any pages on Ezekiel 20:1–24.

Your rules say to use only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and fill no gaps from my own knowledge. Under those rules, anything I wrote now would be unsourced, so I've left it all out rather than guess.

**Next step:** Ask again in a new message and I'll run the research. I was going to start with these pages:
- enduringword.com, Ezekiel 20
- biblehub.com: Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary and Gill on Ezekiel 20
- netbible.org: translator's notes on Ezekiel 20
- preceptaustin.org: its Ezekiel 20 page, if there is one

For the denominational comparisons, I'd search the tradition sites for the two places where they're most likely to differ:
- **Vv. 11, 13 and 21** ("the man who does these things will live by them"): this line is quoted in Romans 10:5 and Galatians 3:12, where Lutheran law-and-gospel teaching and Reformed covenant teaching tend to read it differently.
- **Vv. 12 and 20** (the Sabbath as a sign): Christian traditions disagree about whether the Sabbath still applies to Christians.

For other views, I'd check newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org for Catholic and Orthodox readings, and bibleodyssey.org for modern scholarship.
